mechanism: Alternative regime conditioning: does the regime-conditioned funding effect SUPPORTED for RV (FCLR-XSEC-002, HIGH-RV regime, next-hour RV) and for liquidation intensity (FCLR-XSEC-004/005 LOW-RV; FCLR-XSEC-006 ALL THREE UTC session buckets, next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity) replicate under an alternative regime variable — RV168/RV24 volatility-of-volatility ratio terciles — instead of RV tercile or UTC session bucket, on the same frozen panels?
alternative_regime_variable: rv168h / rv24h volatility-of-volatility ratio, computed per coin-hour where both rv168h and rv24h are non-null; market-wide ratio per hour = mean across coins with a valid ratio at that hour; hours terciled ex-ante into low / mid / high voV regimes.
alternative_regime_variable_contingency_: If per-(hour, voV-tercile) coin cells are too thin for Primary B, fall back to funding-rate-volatility terciles (rolling sd of abs_fund_pct over trailing window) as the pre-approved alternative regime variable for Primary B only.
predictor_primary: abs_funding_pct_trail (FCLR-001) / abs_fund_pct (liquidation panel) within-(hour, voV-tercile) cross-sectional rank; high_funding = top half of coins by rank, low_funding = bottom half within the same (hour, tercile).
outcome_primary_a: next-hour RV per coin = target_rv24h from FCLR-001 panel (shift -1 within coin); FCLR-XSEC-002 estimand restricted to voV-tercile regimes.
outcome_primary_b: next-hour NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED observed liquidation intensity per coin = sum of notional_usd over all observed liquidation events of that coin in hour t+1 (shift -1 within coin); DOLLAR SEVERITY, NOT EVENT COUNT; FCLR-XSEC-006 estimand restricted to voV-tercile regimes.
baseline_a: within-(hour, voV-tercile) RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, tercile)) predicting next-hour RV.
baseline_b: within-(hour, voV-tercile) RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, tercile)) predicting next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity.
inference: block bootstrap across whole UTC hours within each voV-tercile regime family (seed 20261121, >=2000 deterministic replicates); Holm correction over the joint test family; 2% materiality floor (|mean_diff| / mean_abs_outcome >= 0.02).
joint_test_family: voV-tercile HIGH x funding_contrast -> next-hour RV (Primary A)
voV-tercile HIGH x rv_persistence_baseline -> next-hour RV (Primary A baseline)
voV-tercile LOW x funding_contrast -> next-hour notional-weighted liq intensity (Primary B)
voV-tercile LOW x rv_persistence_baseline -> next-hour notional-weighted liq intensity (Primary B baseline)
voV-tercile MID x funding_contrast -> next-hour RV (cross-reference)
voV-tercile MID x funding_contrast -> next-hour notional-weighted liq intensity (cross-reference)
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED only if BOTH primary funding contrasts (Primary A high-voV tercile funding->RV and Primary B any-voV-tercile funding->notional-weighted-liq-intensity) clear all three gates (CI excludes zero, Holm adj_p < 0.05, materiality >= 0.02); otherwise preserve the honest null as NOT_SUPPORTED. Do not threshold-shop; do not relax the 2% floor after seeing outcomes.

cross_panel_reconciliation.description: On the overlapping coins, compare coefficient sign agreement and magnitude of the funding-rank effect between the next-hour RV outcome (Primary A, FCLR-001 panel) and the next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity outcome (Primary B, combined liquidation panel) under the same voV-tercile conditioning.
cross_panel_reconciliation.joint_significance: Both primary contrasts individually clear the gate

FCLR-XSEC-001 (pooled within-hour cross-sectional funding contrast on RV, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
